independent_geometry: Vectorised depth/sense-radius/travel predicates reconstructed directly from sealed trajectories and actor configs, without importing author analysis/helper. All per-frame depth counts, potential-target bird counts, aggregate availability, search counts and median live depth matched.
integration: Trapezoidal time means for continuous depth fields; left-constant saved0.1T durations for booleans.
raw_event_summary_checks: All128 gannet launch/capture totals matched raw transitions/oral events; capture/contact/launch totals matched sealed species summaries. Completion/source hashes and matching identities verified.
limitations: Posthoc descriptive analysis of four previously examined schools; no new independent evidence or primary-validation endpoint.
Potential geometric new-target eligibility is evaluated regardless of actor readiness/committed bout; it is not actual attack-ready time or a causal controller decision.
Surviving-prey denominators and all trajectories change under predator presence; access, disturbance, removal and search effects are not isolated.
Sampled-duration uncertainty applies per transition boundary; do not treat three decimal places as continuous-time precision.
The4.25T average reduction in shallow-unreachable time is entirely one G-only case with17T of that state.
Mean per-school contact-yield changes differ from pooled contacts divided by pooled launches.
Counterexamples exist: some settings gain bird captures despite reduced sampled access, and some gain access without bird feeding gains.
